name: Sanguis et Imperium
source:
"Sanguis et Imperium" is a Visual Novel that takes you back in time through the eyes of Alaire Lacroix, from his youth to his present as a vampire. You will know his pain, his joy, his love, his hopes, his curse, his power and the different girls who left a piece of them in him.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/helheim]Patreon[/url]]
